# Jeremy Schwartz

}}
Jeremy Schwartz is an English businessman, former CEO of the Body Shop, Author and Speaker.
Jeremy Schwartz was CEO of The Body Shop the cosmetics company shortly before it was sold off by L’Oréal. He is a speaker on leadership. Prior to that he worked for L’Oréal UK, Coca-Cola and Sainsbury’s supermarkets.
Business career
Schwartz began his career working at Boston Consulting Group in 1987.
In 1993, he joined L’Oréal, becoming overall marketing director in 1995.
From 2002 to 2005, Schwartz was brand director at Sainsbury's.
Schwartz was CEO and chairman of The Body Shop from 2013 to 2018.
For eight months in 2018-2019, Schwartz was COO of Pandora (not CEO as erroneously claimed on his LinkedIn).
As of 2021, he is chairman for Sustainable Transformation at Kantar.
On 18 September 2024, Coca-Cola filed a claim in court against Schwartz related to Intellectual Property, notably passing off and trade marks. Schwartz did not “invent Coca-Cola Zero,” as previously claimed, and is now saying that he “introduced” it which is more in line with what someone in his marketing role might do.
